Through honest conversations, gospel truths, and practical ideas, we’ll explore intentional parenting, strengthening marriage, finding joy in motherhood, and discovering how God can work through us in every season of life.

Your influence reaches beyond today. We’re building homes that hell can’t break and creating legacies that bless generations.

I’m so glad you’re here. Let’s become matriarchs together.

description:
Drawing on the research behind the exhibition, the twelve audio episodes of Living in San Francesco tell the stories of the people and communities who, over nearly eight centuries, made the complex their home, passed through it or helped shape it. The documents and the monuments themselves inspired the stories written to be heard in the very places they describe.Available via QR codes positioned along the exhibition route, the episodes complement the panels and the bilingual guide. They invite visitors to pause and look closely at an architectural detail, a section of masonry, a fresco or an inscription, and to discover the story that connects it to the place where they stand.

This project has been carried out thanks to Fondazione Cassa di Risparmio di Lucca and Scuola IMT Alti Studi Lucca.

title: Michael Mattie

description:
THE DRAGON’S MERIDIAN
Where Ancient Myth Bleeds into Reality.History records the dates, but myth remembers the truth.In the West, dragons were monsters slain for gold. But across the mist-shrouded gorges, jade rivers, and subterranean calderas of the East, dragons were never beasts to be conquered—they were the living architecture of the world itself.Hosted by Michael Mattie, The Dragon’s Meridian is an immersive, cinematic audio journey into the deepest and darkest corridors of Asian mythology, folklore, and primordial fantasy. Each week, step off the edge of the charted map to encounter shapeshifting nine-tailed spirits, ancient flood-tamers, eight-headed river hydras, and the hidden kings of the sunken seas. Blending rigorous mythological research, forgotten historical chronicles, and visceral, novelistic storytelling, this is folklore stripped of its fairy-tale varnish—raw, psychological, and breathtakingly alive.About the Host:
Michael Mattie is an American narrative folklorist, cultural archivist, and audio storyteller with an obsession for the liminal spaces where geography meets human belief. Having spent years tracking folklore across remote mountain temples, volcanic riverbanks, and classical Taoist and Buddhist pilgrimage routes, Michael brings a warm, cinematic authority and a philosopher’s eye to the microphone. Known for his hypnotic cadence and deep respect for cultural nuance, he doesn't just recite old legends—he reconstructs the psychological world of the ancestors who dared to look into the mist and see a living god staring back.Inside Every Journey:
  • Cinematic Soundscapes: Atmospheric, high-fidelity storytelling built for headphones at midnight.
  • The True History Behind the Myth: The real megafloods, imperial secrets, and volcanic events that birthed ancient monsters.
  • Listener Inquiries: Deep-dive answers exploring the hidden philosophy, psychology, and anatomy of the supernatural.
Close your eyes. Turn down the lights. Follow the current into the deep.

His unique approach draws the attention of those burdened by spiritual afflictions, leading them to his door, desperate for relief.

As his assistant, you bear witness to Brodsky's astonishing methods. Each episode reveals a new patient, each with their own haunting story. From restless spirits to unresolved traumas, these encounters challenge your understanding of reality. Brodsky's investigations delve deep into the human psyche, uncovering hidden fears and unresolved conflicts that manifest in ghostly forms.

But as he journeys further into the unknown, Brodsky faces his own demons. What dark truths lie in the shadows of his past? How far will he go to save a soul? This gripping narrative explores themes of redemption, the power of belief, and the thin line between science and the supernatural. Engage your curiosity and join Dr. Brodsky on a chilling journey that will leave you questioning the very nature of existence. description:
The True Gems Foundation is a platform for women in New Zealand to connect, celebrate, support and inspire. A community of like-minded women at every age and stage, navigating through business, family, finances, health and life, together.

title: Missio Pod
author: Missio Collective
description:
Pastor, you don't have to lead alone.
Missio Pod is four pastors at one table, working through the questions you carry into every week of ministry:
Who really runs the church?
Do we have to preach verse by verse?
Is church membership actually in the Bible?
Is every sermon supposed to be about Jesus?
Why plant another church?
Should you use AI in sermon prep?
What do you do when you don't have elders yet?
Who pastors the pastor?
WHY LISTEN
You get a straight answer. Every episode takes one question and asks what Scripture says, where we stand, and how it works in a real local church.
You hear the other side. We argue the opposing position, we disagree with each other, and we stay at the table.
You leave with something to use. Sermon manuscript word counts. What never gets cut from a membership class. Discipleship pathways. How missions dollars get decided. The books on our shelves. These are the practices our own churches run on.
You hear pastors who are friends. This is mostly the conversation we would be having anyway. It is honest, it is funny, and it is what we want for you: brothers in the work.
SEASON ONE
Eight episodes on the eight distinctives that unite our churches: Christ-Centered, Church Membership, Make Disciples, Engaged in Missions, Expositional Preaching, Elder-Led, Church Planting, and Relational.
AT THE TABLE
Chad Williams, BLDG 28 Church
Timothy Miller, Lakeview Church
Dr. Adam Powers, SonRise Community Church
Frank Gil, Cross & Crown Church
Missio Pod is a conversation on the mission of God and life in the local church, from Missio Collective: a family of Christ-centered, Word-driven, and mission-minded churches partnering together to make disciples, multiply leaders, and plant churches.
If you are looking for a band of brothers who love Christ, His Church, and the mission He has given us, we would be honored to walk with you.

title: Behind the Spark
author: Shannon Adee
description:
How do you rebuild your self-worth and identity after a major life change? Behind the Spark with Shannon Adee explores personal transformation, emotional healing, and the mindset shifts that help you rebuild self-trust and move forward with confidence.
You’ve tried. You’ve started over. You’ve told yourself you just need more willpower, more motivation, more time. And you probably wonder if this is just your destiny. Shannon Adee told herself those things, too. For years, she believed them.
Over 12 years, Shannon Adee navigated personal transformation while losing more than 335 pounds and building a successful business. But the hardest part wasn’t the weight loss, the food, or the routines. It was the internal dialogue, limiting beliefs, self-worth struggles, and learning who she was becoming after the visible change.
She realized lasting change wasn’t about perfection or willpower. It was about rebuilding self-trust, moving forward with confidence, and creating momentum one decision at a time.
Behind the Spark explores the messy middle of personal growth and life transitions. The part no one prepares you for. Not the before. Not the polished after. But the becoming.
This podcast is for anyone trying to reconnect with who they are while navigating a major life change. Change has begun, but clarity, confidence, and ease haven’t fully arrived. You’re no longer who you were, but not yet fully who you’re becoming. Growth can feel isolating, leaving you emotionally exhausted or still catching up internally, even when life looks “better” from the outside.
Growth happens in the hard stuff. The days when you question everything. The nights when the only thing keeping you going is the quiet belief that something better is still unfolding.
Through honest, emotionally intelligent conversations, Shannon Adee explores identity shifts, emotional resilience, mindset transformation, self-worth, and self-leadership. Each episode features people who have lived through profound change, alongside professionals who understand the complexity of long-term growth.
These are the conversations that don’t make it to social media. The self-doubt. The grief. The confusion. The process of letting go of old identities, challenging negative self-talk, and redefining self-worth in real time.
You may be carrying more than you realize. Moving forward takes more than motivation. It takes awareness, compassion, and the internal work of learning to trust yourself again, even when growth feels uncomfortable.
If you’re unsure how to become the person you want to be, or life has changed and you’re still finding your footing, you’re not alone. Follow Behind the Spark and join Shannon Adee on this journey.
About the Host:
Shannon Adee is a transformational speaker, entrepreneur, and founder of Spark Evolution, a platform focused on personal transformation, mindset growth, healing, and emotional resilience.
Through speaking, coaching, and Behind the Spark, Shannon Adee helps people challenge limiting beliefs, reconnect with their self-worth, and navigate the messy middle of becoming.

# In Bed With Emma
Art, Love, All the Woo & a Canvas of the Heart

From beautiful beds on the magical island of Ibiza, join Emma Hack — internationally acclaimed artist, intuitive, storyteller, animal lover and goddess — as she shares 54 years of stories through 54 oracle cards.
Each episode begins with the shuffle of the cards, revealing a surprise theme that takes Emma on an unexpected journey through her world of art, childhood memories, relationships, sexual exploration, animal instinct, adventures, heartbreaks and everything in between.
Some stories are funny, some nostalgic, some a little spicy, and many have changed her life forever.
With honesty, humour, vulnerability and a touch of woo, Emma invites you into her bed and her world, exploring the unexpected connections between creativity, love, intuition and the beautiful messiness of being human.
And here's the twist — even Emma doesn't know which story will unfold until the cards decide.
So get comfortable, snuggle in, and discover a delicious feast for the eyes, ears and heart.

title: The Uncertain Season - Practical Strategies for Midlife Women to Get Clear on What’s Next
author: Sharon Kamassah - Leadership Development Coach and Trainer
description:
This podcast will help you reclaim your rhythm — so you’re the one authoring your next move, not just reacting to it. You’ll walk away with the financial insights, the healthy habits, and the legacy mindset that let you move forward without fear. And you won’t do it alone! You’ll do it inside a community of women in the same in-between, building each other up along the way.
Hi, I’m Sharon. I built a career, raised kids, chased degrees, and started a business, all at once. I also stayed in a role long after it stopped fitting, because too many people counted on me to stay. I couldn’t see past the edge of it. Some nights the math on my family’s future kept me awake. Leaving felt selfish, so I soldiered through the exhaustion, telling myself I wasn’t ready anyway. What changed me was simple: realizing I was worthy of my own dreams too, opportunity can be built, not just found, and I stopped carrying it alone. Now I bring you the systems that helped me get clear, and the resolve to act on it.
If you’re ready to finally answer ”what’s next” instead of dodging the question
Ready to stop saying you’re ”fine” and start building something real
Ready to feel results you can’t ignore: deeper rest, a clearer mind, and becoming 100% more decisive

Take the HIGH way.

We’re all serving a lifetime sentence. Might as well GET CONVICTED.

Elijah’s career is what happens when a classically trained stage actor refuses to stay in one lane. title: You in Business
author: Karen Taylor
description:
Business owner? Business builder? Founder? Freelancer? Chief of everything rather than CEO? Whether your business is still a whisper of an idea you want to explore, you’ve just started, or you’re building something and trying to make it work around everything else in life, this show is for you.
There’s help everywhere for the business. Far less for the person running it. So YOU in Business is the short, practical podcast from Founding Futures CIC for anyone starting or building a small business.
Hosted by Karen Taylor, dual accredited Master Coach, trainer, small business strategist and Founder of Founding Futures CIC, it brings you one useful tool, thought or takeaway at a time. We’ll definitely talk about the practical side of business, pricing, marketing, sales, growth and strategy, but we will always be bringing it back to you. Because behind every business is a human being: YOU. 
Expect the questions most business advice skips, like why saying your price out loud feels so hard, what to focus on when everything feels important, and what you can realistically build with the time and energy you actually have. Warm, practical and straight-talking, with the occasional expert guest and a loving boot when you need one. No hype, no hustle, no jargon. 
As a Community Interest Company, we believe expert support should never depend on a big budget, bags of confidence or the right connections, so we’re here to make it easy to reach, easy to access and easy to use.
New episodes every weekday. Press follow, and find everything we mention at https://www.wearefoundingfutures.org/links

title: Biddy and the Silver Man (A Desert Encounter)
author: Harlan Ellison
description:
When a mysterious figure descends from the sky, the townspeople of a desolate desert community make a fateful decision—they hang him from a tree, believing they’ve captured a devil. But what if this man, dubbed the Silver Man, embodies something far more profound? In "Biddy and the Silver Man," Harlan Ellison crafts a gripping tale that wrestles with themes of faith, sacrifice, and the human condition. As the story unfolds, Biddy, a young girl caught between innocence and the harsh realities of her world, becomes the reluctant witness to the unfolding drama.

The townspeople grapple with their actions, forcing listeners to confront the implications of their choices. Is this divine intervention or a tragic misunderstanding? Ellison's narrative invites you on a thought-provoking journey, questioning the nature of good and evil in a harsh landscape. With vivid characters and a storyline that intertwines desperation and hope, you'll find yourself drawn into a moral quandary that resonates long after the final words.

"Biddy and the Silver Man" challenges you to consider what it means to be human in a world rife with judgment and fear. Discover the profound connections between love, loss, and redemption as you delve into this hauntingly beautiful tale. Join Biddy on her journey, and unravel the mystery that lies in the heart of the desert.

One story can change your perspective. One lesson can change your life. One pebble can create a wave of positivity.
What if the story you need to hear most is waiting for you right here?
Welcome to The Pebble Effect Podcast—where real people share powerful stories, fresh perspectives, and practical life lessons to help you become the best version of yourself and make a positive difference in the world.
Hosted by Coach Bolger, a certified teacher, coach, mentor, and former Division I basketball player, this inspirational and educational podcast is built on one belief: what we learn from each other can change what we do next.
From athletes and entrepreneurs to authors, artists, educators, doctors, wellness experts, and community leaders, our guests bring stories and lessons from many walks of life. You’ll also meet everyday people who have overcome challenges, pursued a dream, or found meaningful ways to help others. We have a special commitment to the younger generation: helping them learn from these experiences, build confidence, and develop skills they can carry into their future.

The trial came to be known as “The Last Jury Trial in India” and it became a lightning rod for concerns about the jury being corrupted by prejudice and the media. In this four-part series, Sonali Chakravarti, a professor of political theory at Wesleyan University, follows the idea of trial by jury from colonial India to the drafting of the Constitution to India’s courts today, and asks what is lost when ordinary people no longer decide who is guilty. From everyday misunderstandings and awkward situations to surprising twists, silly conversations, and laugh-out-loud moments, every episode brings something entertaining and refreshing.

Whether you're driving to work, relaxing at home, taking a break, exercising, or simply looking for something fun to listen to, we've got entertaining moments waiting for you.

What Can You Expect?

Funny and entertaining stories

Everyday life comedy and humor

Crazy situations and unexpected moments

Hilarious conversations and relatable experiences

Lighthearted entertainment and good vibes

Short, enjoyable episodes to brighten your day

We believe laughter brings people together, makes ordinary moments special, and adds happiness to everyday life.

So, put on your headphones, take a break from the stress, and get ready for some seriously funny entertainment!

Seriously Funny Podcast – Laugh More, Stress Less, and Enjoy Every Moment!

Don't forget to follow the podcast and join our growing community of comedy lovers. New episodes bring more stories, more smiles, and more reasons to laugh!

Thanks for listening, and remember: Life is better when you don't take everything too seriously!

title: Healing After Domestic Abuse - Purpose and Biblical Healing for Christian Single Moms
author: Monica Brown
description:
Do you wish you could finally be done with guilt and shame? Are you wanting to re-build your self-worth? Do you want to deepen your relationship with God? Feeling so stretched thin someone could read their phone through you…? 

I am so grateful you're here!

This podcast will help you feel more whole, have peace, children that are happier, strengthen your relationship with God, and enhance your confidence!

Hey, I'm Monica. A mom, a domestic abuse survivor, and Jesus lover. For several years, I tried to heal from all of the toxic relationships I had been in and from growing up with a physically and emotionally abusive father.

I was going to all of the seminars, watching or reading the self-help videos, and it all left me feeling the same way as I did when I went in or finished the book or video.

I found the way that healed me and my children.  Small daily changes that become your new life. That I desire to share it with you and want to walk alongside you!

If you are ready to finally find wholeness that is designed for a survivor..

The tools that build a more peaceful home.

Learn about the deep love God has for you.

Results that are unmistakable like real confidence, healing, happier kids, and know who you are in Christ - this podcast is for you!

Good morning sunshine, pour yourself a fresh cup of coffee, grab you Bible and let’s trade survival mode for purpose.

title: Rachel Lawson's The Magicians: The Age Of Avalon
author: Rachel Lawson
description:
Welcome to the serialized reading of The Age of Avalon by Rachel Lawson.

When a family from modern Australia accidentally travels through time, they find themselves trapped in the age of legends. Camelot is real. Merlin walks among kings. Avalon hides ancient secrets beneath silver waters.

As history unfolds around them, they become part of the stories they once thought were myths. Yet some legends are not about glory. They are about impossible choices, forbidden love, sacrifice, and the dreams that endure long after kingdoms fall.

Join us for each chapter of this epic fantasy adventure as we journey through the Age of Avalon, one episode at a time.

title: Healing From Divorce l Connection, Identity, Prayer
author: Tia Cunningham
description:
Did you lose your identity after your divorce?

Do you wish you had a community of women walking alongside you as you rebuild your life? Are you carrying guilt, shame, or confusion about who you are now as a divorced Christian woman?

You don’t have to figure out how to heal and rebuild your life alone.

This podcast will help you rediscover your identity in Christ, build meaningful community, and let go of the guilt and shame you’ve been carrying for far too long.

Hey, I’m Tia. I’m a divorced mom, with four kids, who found her way back to Jesus. 

After my divorce, I went on quite a journey to heal my heart and rebuild my life. I went deep into the New Age, searching for healing and trying to find my way forward on my own. I isolated myself, thinking I could heal myself.

But it wasn’t until I surrendered my life to Jesus that I finally experienced true peace and lasting healing.

Through prayer, inner healing, deliverance, and spending daily time in God’s Word, I began to see myself differently. I began to understand who I was in Christ. And I discovered that healing wasn’t meant to happen in isolation. Finding other women who were growing in Christ became a huge part of my own healing journey.

Now, I want to help you do the same.

Here, we’ll talk about the real stuff that comes after divorce: healing your heart, rebuilding your identity, finding your people, deepening your relationship with Jesus, and creating a new life rooted in Christ.

If you’re ready to stop surviving and start rebuilding, you’re in the right place.

title: EU Emergency Kit: The Citizen's Guide
author: baradellopublishing@proton.me
description:
We live in an era where normality has become fragile. Scenarios we once associated with science fiction films—prolonged blackouts, cyberattacks on essential services, geopolitical tensions on the borders of the European Union, and hybrid threats—have now become part of our daily reality. This is not about fear-mongering; it is about acknowledging the facts: various groups and foreign powers aim to destabilize our democracies by sowing fear, distrust, and social paralysis.
The response from the European Union and individual member states is not resignation, but preparation. The "EU Emergency Kit" is not a symbol of alarmism, but rather a new standard for informed citizenship—a collection of tools, habits, and action plans designed to help us transition from vulnerable individuals into resilient communities.
This 10-episode podcast will guide you, step by step, on a clear, practical, and fast-paced journey, combining an analysis of recent geopolitical events with actionable, immediate advice.
Episode Index:
Episode 1: The New Landscape: Why Europe Is Asking Us to Be Prepared
Episode 2: Beyond the Blackout: When the Power Grid Shuts Down
Episode 3: The Invisible War: Cyberattacks and Everyday Digital Security
Episode 4: Alerts and Contested Skies: Managing Aerial Threats and Urban Emergencies
Episode 5: The EU Survival Kit: Anatomy of the Perfect Backpack for the First 72 Hours
Episode 6: Water, Food, and Supplies: Household Self-Sufficiency That Saves Lives
Episode 7: Communicating in Chaos: What to Do When Phones Stop Working
Episode 8: The Psychology of Emergencies: Overcoming Panic and Maintaining Control
Episode 9: Local Networks: Apartment Buildings and Neighborhoods as a First Line of Defense
Episode 10: Conscious Resilience: Transforming Fear into Collective Strength
Episode 11: The Dawn of Awareness: From
Preparation to Lasting Peace

title: Counsels of Old
author: Andrew Nevins
description:
Welcome to Counsels of Old, a podcast dedicated to opening up conversations about God's Word through biblical questions, thoughtful discussions, and practical applications for everyday life.
Our name comes from Isaiah 25:1:
"O LORD, thou art my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful things; thy counsels of old are faithfulness and truth."
Our desire is to return to the Scriptures, examine God's counsel, and strive to follow the pattern of the church we read about in Acts chapter 2.
We invite you to join us in studying God's Word, and if you're in the Opelika, Alabama area, come worship with us at Opelika Church, located at 2660 Cunningham Drive.
Sunday Bible Class begins at 2:30 PM, worship at 3:30 PM, and Wednesday Bible Class at 6:30 PM.
Thanks for listening, and welcome to Counsels of Old!

title: History With the Heathen
author: Richard McCardle
description:
Welcome! I'm Richard, aka The Heathen, from the Heathen's Wasteland stream on Twitch. I've recently begun discussing historical events, people, and mythologies in a pretty relaxed, broad-strokes kind of way while I play video games. This show is where I'll get into more detail on the things I discuss on my stream for those who are interested to know a bit more of the meat and potatoes of my topics, though still with a relaxed and informal vibe. Enjoy!


Please note, I'm not an academic or an expert. Just a guy with an unhealthy level of interest in history. What this means: while I have no formal education in history, I have done a ridiculous amount of research just to sate my curiosity. So sit back and relax as I discuss the history of humanity, one topic at a time, from the perspective of this Heathen.


Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/theheathenamongyou


Socials are in the works. I'll put the links here as soon as they're ready.


Music is from Monument Studios (monumentstudios.net).

title: Old Camp Road - Hunting & Homesteading
author: Sportsmen's Empire
description:
The Old Camp Road is a podcast about hunting, fishing, homesteading, and life outdoors in the South. We’ll share stories from deer camp, days on the water, life around the homestead, and the experiences that have made the outdoors such a big part of our lives. Some episodes will take us back to hunts and memories from years ago, while others will cover what’s happening right now during the current hunting season. We’ll talk about the good days, the tough ones, lessons learned, and everything that happens along the way.
We’ll also bring on guests to share their own stories and experiences from the outdoors. We’ll hear about memorable hunts from the past, talk about what they’re doing during the current season, and hear the stories behind the places and people that mean the most to them. Whether it’s hunting, fishing, managing land, homesteading, or just sitting around telling stories from camp, the goal is to have the kind of conversations outdoorsmen have been having for generations. It’s all part of the story here on The Old Camp Road.

title: Park in Five
author: Park in 30 Seconds
description: Park in Five is a short podcast about America's national parks — one park per episode, told in about five minutes. Your host is Mike, a teacher who can't seem to stop visiting national parks. Each episode tells one park's story: how it came to be, what makes it different, and the people who were there long before it had a name. Then the one thing that matters most if you go — "If you only do one thing there, do this." Every episode closes the same way: "And when you're there, look for this bird" — and the bird's own real song to take you out.

8301 Wrestling Podcast is where two generations of wrestling fans meet to talk the business they love. Hosted by Marcus E. Brown and Chris J. Long, the show brings together an old-school perspective and a newer-era point of view to break down everything happening in WWE.
From Raw and SmackDown to Premium Live Events, classic rivalries, legendary wrestlers, unforgettable matches, and the hottest stories in the current product, 8301 covers wrestling from every angle. Each episode delivers honest reactions, match breakdowns, strong opinions, and real debate from two fans who came into wrestling.

title: Good Energy & The Body: A Wellness Podcast
author: Alyssa Flynn
description:
What is good energy and where does it come from? Why do certain people, places, experiences, and environments make us feel so good? How does it influence our health and the way our body feels? 


If you have you been frustrated by mysterious health symptoms, stress, or simply not feeling like yourself lately, maybe you are curious about looking at a bigger picture, the connection between mind and body, and the impact of lifestyle on wellness.


If you want to understand the "why" behind our body's symptoms, and want to seek out a more holistic wellness approach, but feel overwhelmed with where to start, this podcast is for you.


Here we explore first hand wellness "secrets" from holistic practitioners, healers, athletes, and business leaders that get us to explore the connection between the way we live our lives with the way we feel in our bodies. Experts will share how they generate good energy and vibrations in their minds, bodies, and lives to create success and well-being. 


Because when we understand that everything is connected and we are all made up of energy we can create a body, mind, and life that feels good. 


"Everything is energy and that is all there is to it. Match the frequency of the reality you want and you can not help but get that reality. It can be no other way. This is not philosophy this is physics." -Albert Einstein

title: A Jewel in my Pocket - Reiki, Animism and Worldview
author: Helena Mountainsong
description:
Step into the animistic…. the land is alive… connect deeply… listen to her speak… and dance to her rhythm… 

This is a podcast about finding belonging and deeper relationship with the land and the beings of the land, through a beautiful and beloved Japanese spiritual practice …Reiki. 
We seek to uncover the worldviews that shape our experience and our sense of belonging or of disconnection. And we seek to face into the truths of the land and promote indigenous ally-ship. 

With Helena Mountainsong, a deep voiced neurodivergent trans woman, and deeply grounded and experienced healer, storyteller and space holder.

(Podcast is made in a facility that also processes neurodivergent style thinking and tree nuts. May contain traces of humour)

title: Cap’n Dan’s Daughter (Wealth and Ambition)
author: Joseph Crosby Lincoln
description: Cap’n Dan’s unexpected fortune flips his world upside down when a windfall from a distant relative arrives, but this newfound wealth sparks chaos in his cozy Cape Cod home. As the owner of a humble dry goods and variety store, Cap’n Dan has always valued simplicity over extravagance. Now, his wife’s high-society aspirations clash with his down-to-earth sensibilities, leading to hilarious misunderstandings and heartwarming moments that reveal the true value of family. Can Cap’n Dan navigate the challenges of wealth without losing the charm of his everyday life? Join him on a rollercoaster journey filled with quirky characters, comical situations, and a delightful exploration of the clash between old-fashioned values and the allure of high society. In this lighthearted novel, Joseph Crosby Lincoln masterfully weaves humor with relatable conflicts, inviting you to laugh, reflect, and root for Cap’n Dan as he discovers what truly matters. Whether you’re a fan of classic humor or looking for a fresh story that resonates with modern dilemmas, Cap’n Dan’s Daughter promises to entertain and engage you from start to finish. Tune in for an audiobook experience that highlights the charm of coastal living, the complexity of relationships, and the enduring spirit of community.

title: Unpacked Thoughts
author: globetreaders
description:
The space where we strip away the noise and dive into what really matters. Here, we explore life’s philosophies, the journeys that shape us, and the stories that remind us to pause, reflect, and grow.
Whether you are a dreamer searching for clarity, or a professional navigating the chaos of everyday life, this is your moment to breathe, to think, and to reconnect with yourself.
Together, we’ll unpack experiences from travel, culture, and the mind—because wisdom isn’t filtered, it’s lived.
Fear. It’s the shadow that follows us, the whisper that holds us back, and yet—the spark that can push us forward. Today, we’re peeling back the layers of fear, not to escape it, but to understand it… and maybe even transform it into strength.

author: DharmaActually
description:
**Dharma, Actually** is a podcast about Hinduism, morality, religion, philosophy, and the difficult questions that sit between them.
Hosted by Mr. Kevin, the show begins with Hindu stories, scriptures, characters, and ideas, then follows those questions wherever they lead — into other religions, philosophy, history, pop culture, and everyday life.
What is Dharma? Can a religious person still be evil? When does loyalty become destructive? Is doing the right thing always the same as following the rules?
This is not a sermon and it is not a lecture. It is a conversation built around curiosity,

title: Men of the Deep Waters (Cyclone Terror on the High Seas)
author: William Hope Hodgson
description:
A monstrous cyclone descends upon the ship, tearing apart the very fabric of the ocean and leaving its crew at the mercy of nature's fury. In "Men of the Deep Waters," William Hope Hodgson immerses you in a harrowing adventure where survival hinges on courage and ingenuity. As the storm rages, the crew faces more than just the elements; they confront their deepest fears and the unknown horrors lurking beneath the waves.

This gripping tale follows the ship's captain and his men as they navigate treacherous waters, battling not only the relentless storm but also the eerie, supernatural forces that threaten to drag them into the abyss. Friendship, loyalty, and the indomitable human spirit shine through as they uncover secrets hidden in the deep—secrets that challenge their beliefs and test their resolve.

Listeners will be captivated by the vivid descriptions of the chaos above and the mysteries below. Hodgson's rich narrative style draws you into a world where every wave could bring salvation or doom. Will the crew escape the cyclone's clutches, or will they be swallowed by the dark, deep waters? Dive into this classic adventure that blends action, suspense, and a touch of the supernatural, perfect for fans of high-seas thrillers and psychological exploration. Experience the terror and wonder of the ocean like never before.

title: Plan Beyond the Paycheck
author: Dr Brendan Miner, MD
description:
Plan Beyond the Paycheck

Plan Beyond the Paycheck is a podcast hosted by Dr. Brendan Miner exploring what comes after building a successful career and a strong income.

Drawing from more than two decades in medicine, years of real estate investing, and his experience building Miner Capital Partners, Brendan talks about multifamily real estate, investing, financial options, career, time, family, and what it means to build outside the traditional path.

The goal is not simply to talk about making more money. It is to have practical conversations about how people can use the success they have already created to build additional financial pillars, greater flexibility, and more choices for the future.

Episodes will include conversations about real estate opportunities, interest rates, financing, how multifamily investments work, lessons learned along the way, and perspectives from other professionals and investors.

Brendan also welcomes different ideas, experiences, and points of view. If you have a story, area of expertise, or perspective that fits the conversations on Plan Beyond the Paycheck and you believe you would be a good guest, he would be glad to hear from you.

Connect with Brendan on LinkedIn or reach out by email.

New episodes twice each month.

Learn more about Dr. Brendan Miner and Miner Capital Partners at minercapitalpartners.com.

description: On-Chain Brief is a short, independent podcast that reads crypto trading apps the slow way: official fee pages, terms, and help docs, checked on a stated date and read out plainly. Each episode covers one app, its costs, its limits, and its risks. Some episodes mention a referral code or link we may earn from. Nothing here is financial advice. Crypto trading is risky and you can lose money. 18+ only.

title: Built in the Bayou City
author: Joshua Latimer
description: Every episode, Ed Hamilton sits down with one business owner from around Houston and gets into how they actually built it. They call it the Bayou City for a reason: every hard rain the water comes up, and every time, this city cleans up and keeps building. One owner an episode, from Brazoria to The Woodlands, on the record about how it started, the stretch that nearly sank it, and what is working now. About 15 minutes. No theory. No pitch. Grab a chair.

title: Beyond Rehab
author: Dr. Bri Thornton, PT, DPT, CFMP
description:
Welcome to Beyond Rehab, a podcast for rehab providers who want to think bigger about patient care and what’s possible for their careers.

Hosted by Dr. Bri Thornton, physical therapist, functional medicine practitioner, and practice owner, Beyond Rehab explores how functional medicine, lifestyle, and whole-person care can expand the way we approach rehabilitation. From gut health, hormones, and nutrition to sleep, stress, and recovery, we connect the dots between the person in front of you and the progress you’re working toward.

We also talk honestly about burnout, business ownership, and creating a career with more flexibility, fulfillment, and room to grow.

Your patients are more than a musculoskeletal system and your career can be more than traditional rehab.

It’s time to go Beyond Rehab.

description:
When my husband died, the table went quiet.
I was a fashion designer, and I had a life I thought I understood. Then everything changed, and I had to decide who I was going to be next.So I started over. I trained as a French chef at Le Cordon Bleu. I won a cooking competition in London. I worked in a Michelin-starred kitchen. Then I moved to Bangkok to train Muay Thai, and at 40 I stepped into the ring and won my first fight.
You are not eating alone. You are setting a table for the life you’re building.
Pull up a chair.New episodes weekly.

title: Sacred Steps: Bridges Built Over Troubled Waters.
author: Danielle Montgomery
description:
Welcome to the midnight sanctuary. For many years, I was the solo emotional anchor—the uncompensated caregiver, the one absorbing the trauma, and the one hitting rock bottom as my marriage ended and pillars of strength crumbled. But the storm didn't break me; it woke me up. Now, at almost 50, my anxiety is gone, my intuitive gifts are wide open, and I am standing fully in my power. It led me to sacred steps in lonely shoes and redefined me
This podcast is a raw, unfiltered blueprint for the caretakers, the silent badasses, and anyone currently sitting at the bottom of a storm they didn’t ask for. We aren't here to mourn the troubled waters; we are here to architect the bridge over them. Pull up a chair, put down your heavy armor, and let’s make a big impact together. New episodes every week.

title: Soul, Interrupted
author: Samantha Noelle
description:
Soul, Interrupted with Samantha Noelle


What happens when life doesn't go according to plan? Or what if it was part of the plan all along?


Welcome to Soul, Interrupted, where we explore the messy, beautiful, and sometimes downright ridiculous experience of being human.


Hosted by Samantha Noelle, Psychic Medium and Spiritual Teacher, this podcast brings together spiritual wisdom, real-life experiences, and honest conversations about the things that shape us.


From mindset, purpose, and resilience to grief, relationships, spiritual awakenings, and life after death, nothing is off the table.


Drawing on her experiences as a psychic medium and the lessons learned from navigating life's unexpected twists and turns, Samantha offers a grounded, sometimes provocative perspective on who we are, why we're here, and what we're meant to learn along the way.


Expect thought-provoking conversations, practical insights, a little humour, and absolutely no spiritual fluff.


Because sometimes life doesn't fall apart. It interrupts us long enough to remember who we really are.
